name: Yajiang-1 AI Computing Center
notes: Reported as Tibet's first large-scale AI-focused computing center, opened in Shannan on 2025-06-18 as part of Eastern Data, Western Computing; capacity in MW not disclosed.

name: Aksu City Public Computing Platform Project Phase I
notes: Huafu described the Aksu city public AI computing platform as normally progressing, with civil construction preparation under way; earlier company interaction said Phase I would use 10,000 intelligent computing cards and serve government, universities, research bodies, and enterprises.

name: Digital Aksu Geospatial Data Service Platform / Geospatial Big Data Center
developer: Aksu Prefecture Natural Resources Bureau; Xinjiang Gudao Spacetime Information Technology Co.
notes: Government-backed PPP completed acceptance in August 2023; includes a regional geospatial big data center and data sharing service platform, but no MW capacity disclosed.

name: Altay Green Low-Carbon Intelligent Computing Center
notes: Total investment reported at 2.5 billion yuan, planned compute scale 20,000P and 20,000 intelligent-computing cabinets; construction began April 2025 and main structure was reported topped out in July 2025.

name: United Intelligent Computing Center Bole Cloud Server Room Project
developer: Shenzhen Yongweiheng Technology Co.; Guoxin Taichu
notes: Project in Bole City reported started on 2025-04-13 with total investment of 800 million yuan, two phases, planned 3,000P compute scale; first phase focused on 1,000P infrastructure and was planned for August 2025 operation.
